page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.8xlarge is a dedicated compute-optimized instance engineered for computationally demanding applications. Running on the KVM hypervisor with the x86_64 instruction set, the instance is powered by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. It delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB allocated per virtual core.

The hardware configuration contains no bundled local storage, functioning as a stateless node that relies on network-attached storage solutions for disk operations and state retention. It does not integrate any discrete GPUs or hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for data movement across cloud resources.

By maintaining a dense processor configuration relative to memory capacity, the instance maximizes CPU throughput without the resource overhead of excess RAM allocations. This profile fits compute-bound operations, including CI/CD build environments, distributed compilation tasks, batch data processing pipelines, web serving fleets, and algorithmic worker nodes.
